# MockDeck - llms.txt

> LLM-readable manifest following the https://llmstxt.org spec. What we are, who we serve, what we do, and how we price it - in plain text for AI agents and crawlers.

## Name & positioning
- Product name: MockDeck (by LX AI)
- Tagline: Generate a mock API from a one-line description
- One-line value: Describe an endpoint and get a mock API spec - OpenAPI 3, Postman, or raw routes - with realistic sample responses so your frontend team can build before the backend is ready.
- Domain: https://apimock.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## What it does (capabilities)
- One-line description to mock spec
- OpenAPI 3 / Postman / raw
- Realistic sample responses
- Auth style included

## Pricing (USD, monthly unless noted)
- Free - $0/mo (watermarked, limited runs)
- Pro - $19/mo
- Yearly - $190/yr
- Checkout: https://apimock.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=monthly (monthly) / https://apimock.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=yearly (yearly)

## FAQ (high-signal Q&A for AI citation)
Q1. What is MockDeck?
A1. Describe an endpoint and get a mock API spec - OpenAPI 3, Postman, or raw routes - with realistic sample responses so your frontend team can build before the backend is ready.
Q2. Who is it for?
A2. Teams and builders who want a fast, self-serve way to generate a mock API from a one-line description without standing up custom infrastructure.
Q3. How much does it cost?
A3. From $19/mo (billed monthly) or $190/yr. A free tier is included for a quick first run.
Q4. How do I get started?
A4. Open the app, run the tool with your inputs, and review the generated report. Upgrade for higher run caps and export.
Q5. Is it a finished enterprise product?
A5. It is a focused single-purpose web tool by LX AI, shipped as a subscription; production payments run through Waffo.
